idea-plugin.name: Dex Figma Tokens
idea-plugin.description:
Generates Kotlin design-token source straight from the open Figma file, without leaving the IDE and without exporting any file.

Point this plugin at a local checkout of the Figma-Output-Normalizer repository and press Build Generator once. The IDE then runs a local bridge that the repo's Figma plugin connects to; pressing Generate pulls the tokens from Figma and streams the generator's output into an embedded console.

Features:
  • Live bridge and Figma plugin status; Generate is enabled only when a Figma file is connected and ready
  • Optional Figma file key pin
  • Dry-run preview that writes nothing
  • --layout legacy toggle for consumers coupled to the old per-branch package shape
  • Check Environment validates npm, node and the configured checkout
Requires Node.js (with npm), Figma desktop and a Figma-Output-Normalizer checkout.
